## What problem does this solve?

What are you trying to do that TuneLedger doesn't support today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see happen. If this is a new import source (like the planned Apple
Music / YouTube support), note what data that source can realistically provide - see the
README's [Roadmap](../../README.md#roadmap) for the shape new sources are expected to fit.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why this one seems best.

## Additional context

Anything else - mockups, links, examples from other tools, etc.
